bridge-type.label: Navimow Account
bridge-type.description: Connects to the Navimow cloud service and manages MQTT real-time updates.

parameter.name: pollingInterval
parameter.label: Polling Interval
parameter.description: Interval in seconds for HTTP fallback polling. Set to 0 to disable polling (MQTT only).

parameter.name: apiBaseUrl
parameter.label: API Base URL
parameter.description: Override the Navimow API base URL. Leave empty to use the default.

thing-type.label: Navimow Mower
thing-type.description: A Segway Navimow robotic lawn mower.

parameter.name: deviceId
parameter.label: Device ID
parameter.description: The unique device ID of the Navimow mower.

channel-type.label: Status
channel-type.description: Current operational state of the mower.

channel-type.label: Signal Strength
channel-type.description: RSSI signal strength of the mower (dBm).

channel-type.label: Location
channel-type.description: Current GPS position of the mower (latitude, longitude).

channel-type.label: Error Code
channel-type.description: Error code reported by the mower, or "none" if there is no error.

channel-type.label: Current Mow Boundary
channel-type.description: Boundary identifier reported by the location telemetry stream.

channel-type.label: Current Mow Progress
channel-type.description: Mowing progress percentage reported by the location telemetry stream (raw value divided by 100).

channel-type.label: Mowing Percentage
channel-type.description: Current mowing completion percentage from the location telemetry stream.

channel-type.label: Mowing Week Area
channel-type.description: Total area reported as mowed this week by the location telemetry stream (raw value in square meters).

channel-type.label: Subtotal Area
channel-type.description: Current activity subtotal area reported by the location telemetry stream (raw value in square meters).

channel-type.label: Mow Start Type
channel-type.description: Mowing start type indicator from the location telemetry stream (format to be determined).

channel-type.label: Posture Theta
channel-type.description: Heading angle reported by the location telemetry stream.

channel-type.label: Posture X
channel-type.description: Posture X coordinate inside the current zone reported by the location telemetry stream.

channel-type.label: Posture Y
channel-type.description: Posture Y coordinate inside the current zone reported by the location telemetry stream.

channel-type.label: Command
channel-type.description: Send a command to the mower.
